verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3 is an AI accelerator driven programmatically through its software stack. Its docs say they include API references and show PyTorch integration for training, inference and serving, so a documented programmatic interface exists, but the pack only mentions it in passing. The OpenAPI probes returned 404, which fits a hardware SDK rather than a web service, so that absence does not contradict the API claim. missing for 10: concrete API reference content (endpoints/functions/signatures), evidence of programmatic control surfaces beyond framework integration, machine-readable docs (llms.txt/markdown both 404), independent hands-on corroboration
